# Permit Engineering (Eng Tech Net, Inc.)

> Signed and sealed permit drawings for fire alarm, access control, low voltage/CCTV, electrical, and structural sign contractors across Florida. Designed by Marlon Sebelen, a Florida Professional Engineer (Electrical, PE No. 67659) who is also a licensed Florida Electrical Contractor (EC13004430) and NICET Level III certified, with 25 years in the fire alarm and access control industry.

## Services
- Fire alarm permit drawings: risers, device layouts, NAC circuits, sequence of operations, battery calculations (NFPA 72, FBC, FFPC)
- Access control permit drawings: door schedules and hardware
- Low voltage, CCTV and intrusion permit drawings
- Electrical permit drawings: power plans, panel schedules, load calculations, service changes (NFPA 70/NEC)
- Structural sign permit drawings: channel letters, storefront signs, attachment and wind load
